name: querylens-node
description: QueryLens SDK for Node.js: monitors the queries your app sends to PostgreSQL (pg, postgres.js) and MySQL (mysql2), through Sequelize, Knex, TypeORM, Drizzle, Prisma or the drivers, in production, with values removed, and reports N+1s, loops, slow and failing statements to your QueryLens backend, with fixes for your ORM.
